en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of an ornate, multi-story building in early 20th-century architectural style, likely the Jugendstil (Art Nouveau) typical of Germany. Several curved balconies and large windows are visible, and above the door, the name 'Hotel Kaiserhof' can be read. The street is cobblestoned and shaded by tall trees. On the back, handwritten correspondence fills the left side, while the right side is addressed. Stamps and postal marks are visible, as is the sender's museum mark: 'Museum Im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.'
